correctness.rationale: Writing R(e1)=ae1+be2, R(e2)=ce1+de2 and applying the weight-zero Rota–Baxter identity to (e1,e2) yields c²=0, hence c=0 over a field; (e1,e1) then gives a(a−2d)=0, including char 2. The automorphism group follows from φ(e2)=φ(e1)²=s²e2 (s≠0), and explicit triangular-matrix conjugation sends b to sb+(a−d)t/s. The cases a=d=0 give {0,N}, and all remaining branches have a−d≠0 so b may be killed; char2 collapses the 2d branch. This derives complete mutually exclusive normal forms 0,N,P_d,Q_d (char odd), 0,N,P_d (char2), q-dependent class and orbit-size distributions. Independently checked the defining identity and orbit actions for GF2,GF3,GF5,GF7; (operator counts, orbit counts) were (4,3),(15,6),(45,10),(91,14). Exhaustive finite checks are corroboration, not an arbitrary-field proof. Assumes fields, not rings or scheme-point multiplicities.
